Just average. Lot of room for improvement
Dec 2023 • Couples
We decided to visit this restaurant after reading all the positive reviews here on Tripadvisor and frankly we were disappointed. 
The place was empty apart from another table, while the rest of the restaurants in the area were full… this should’ve been the first warning.
Despite the place being empty we were sit at a small table next to the kitchen which I felt odd as in this case it was not one of those fascinating experiences where you dine while you watch the chefs cooking… all we experienced was a chef whistling…
We ordered 2 starters and 2 main courses which arrived pretty quick, with the main courses coming 3 minutes after the starters were served while we were still eating them. 
The food was ok: the spring rolls really nice, noodles and pho average, very large portions a bit over cooked.
Service felt really rushed, we were served 2 starters and 2 main courses and the bills in less than 30’! with 3 waiters always around the table to remove a piece here and there to make more room on the small table when they could have simply given us a bigger table since the restaurant was empty…
The price was ok, but for the same price there are better options in Hanoi Old Quarter.
Overall an odd experience, forgettable food and not a restaurant where I’d go back.
